title: Signal: Composer accepts unstable packages globally
scope: A composer.json file that declares a `minimum-stability` below stable.
limitations: It matches a `minimum-stability` below stable in the parsed composer.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A composer.json that mentions a `minimum-stability` below stable in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
